title: DocuLink Python Worker Protocol v1
description: Defines the newline-delimited JSON messages exchanged between the C# host and the Python worker over stdin/stdout. The worker handles two commands: 'ocr' (extract sidecar text geometry from a PDF without adding a PDF text layer) and 'convert' (turn a non-PDF source document into a PDF, or into HTML for the host to render).

OcrMode.description: full: return the sanitized visual PDF together with sidecar geometry. geometry-only: return sidecar geometry without PDF bytes. Neither mode writes OCR text into the PDF.

OcrJob.description: Sent by the C# host to the worker via stdin. One JSON object per line.

job_id.description: Opaque identifier echoed back in all responses for this job.

ConvertOutputKind.description: pdf: the worker produced finished PDF bytes. html: the worker could only normalise the source to HTML (e.g. .eml) and the host must render it to PDF itself.

ConvertJob.description: Sent by the C# host to the worker via stdin to convert a non-PDF source document. One JSON object per line.

job_id.description: Opaque identifier echoed back in all responses for this job.

source_base64.description: Base-64 encoded bytes of the source document.

source_extension.description: Lower-case source extension including the leading dot, e.g. '.png'. Determines which conversion path the worker takes.

source_name.description: Original file name, used for document titles and error messages. Optional.

ConvertSuccessMessage.description: Emitted by the worker to stdout when conversion completes successfully. Exactly one per convert job.

pdf_base64.description: Base-64 encoded output PDF bytes. Present when output_kind is 'pdf'.

html.description: Self-contained HTML document. Present when output_kind is 'html'.

OcrProgressMessage.description: Emitted by the worker to stdout during processing. Zero or more per job (both commands).

OcrDiagnostics.description: Non-authoritative telemetry describing how a job was processed. Intended for the host debug log only — hosts must not branch behaviour on these values, and must tolerate the object being absent entirely.

ocr_engine.description: OCR engine and version actually used, e.g. 'tesseract 5.5.0'. 'none' when the job performed no OCR.

rasterizer.description: Page rasterizer used for OCR. 'pymupdf' identifies direct hOCR-to-geometry recognition; 'none' means source geometry was reused without rasterization.

mode.description: Final geometry processing mode. 'direct' recognizes selected pages through Tesseract hOCR, 'direct-table' performs cell-aware recognition on a native-text page, and 'none' reuses trusted source geometry.

selected_profile.description: Recognition profile whose sidecar geometry was returned.

evaluated_profiles.description: Direct Tesseract layouts executed while selecting page geometry. Oriented and cropped results are mapped back into unchanged source-page coordinates.

initial_characters.description: Extractable characters produced by the first OCR pass before any adaptive retry.

initial_non_whitespace_characters.description: Non-whitespace characters produced by the first OCR pass.

initial_alphanumeric_ratio.description: Document-wide fraction of initial non-whitespace characters that are letters or digits. Page-local fields are authoritative for detecting corruption because healthy pages can conceal broken pages in this aggregate.

initial_garbled_page_count.description: Number of pages whose initial text geometry contained a meaningful sample dominated by punctuation, invalid Unicode, or multiple garbage lines.

initial_garbled_page_numbers.description: One-based page numbers classified as garbled after the first pass.

final_characters.description: Extractable characters in the PDF and geometry returned to the host.

final_non_whitespace_characters.description: Non-whitespace characters in the returned geometry.

final_alphanumeric_ratio.description: Fraction of final non-whitespace characters that are letters or digits.

final_garbled_page_count.description: Number of pages still classified as garbled in the returned geometry.

final_garbled_page_numbers.description: One-based page numbers still classified as garbled after all retries.

forced_page_count.description: Number of pages re-recognized because hidden or coincident source text could not be trusted.

forced_page_numbers.description: One-based pages re-recognized because source geometry could not be reused.

quality_warning.description: True when the returned OCR result still has implausibly sparse text coverage after all safe retries. Telemetry only; the host continues to treat the message as a successful result.

date_tables_detected.description: Ruled tables whose OCR-visible header identified at least one date column for cell-level recovery.

date_cells_detected.description: Data cells examined beneath OCR-visible date-column headers.

date_cells_resolved.description: Detected date cells recovered as validated MM/DD/YYYY values in sidecar geometry.

date_cells_unresolved.description: Detected date cells that remained blank or invalid after the bounded cell-level retry ladder.

date_recovery_ms.description: Milliseconds spent detecting ruled date tables and recognizing individual date cells.

date_recovery_error.description: Present when optional table-date recovery failed and the worker safely retained the selected OCR result.

table_cells_detected.description: Header and data cells examined by ruled-table cell recovery, including date cells.

table_cells_resolved.description: Ruled-table cells recovered as validated dates, numbers, or non-empty text in sidecar geometry.

table_cells_unresolved.description: Ruled-table cells that remained blank after the bounded column-aware OCR ladder.

table_images_examined.description: Unique source PDF images considered by ruled-table recovery.

table_images_skipped_small.description: Source images rejected before decoding because their largest page placement was too small to contain a recoverable table.

table_grid_candidates.description: Images whose dark-pixel projections contained a strong ruled grid and therefore reached header evaluation.

table_text_recovery_ms.description: Milliseconds spent recognizing cells with column-aware profiles and replacing their sidecar geometry region.

table_text_recovery_error.description: Present when optional full-table cell recovery failed and the worker safely retained the selected OCR result.

table_structure_ms.description: Milliseconds spent detecting and encoding the table-structure-v1 model.

table_structure_error.description: Present when optional table-structure detection failed and the worker safely retained the OCR result.

table_detector_version.description: Identifier of the table detector that produced the returned table-structure-v1 model. Bumped whenever detection behaviour changes, so cached structures from an older detector can be told apart.

table_pages_detected.description: Pages examined by table detection. Fewer than page_count when detection stopped at its time budget.

table_structure_truncated.description: Present when detection stopped early against its wall-clock budget. The pages already detected are published; later pages carry no tables because they were never examined.

table_candidates_generated.description: Regions proposed by the ruled, whitespace and mixed candidate generators before fitting and validation.

table_candidates_emitted.description: Candidates that survived grid fitting, refinement, scoring and deduplication and were published in the model.

table_evidence_ruled.description: Published tables whose columns and rows came from drawn rules alone.

table_evidence_whitespace.description: Published tables whose columns and rows came from shared whitespace corridors alone.

table_evidence_mixed.description: Published tables supported by both drawn rules and whitespace alignment.

table_period_analysis.description: Whether the alpha period analysis ran for this job. When false, every table's period field is null; when true, tables report what span of time their data is dated to. Off by default.

table_rejections.description: Count of rejected candidates by reason, keyed by the dominant penalty or failure (for example "graphics", "marker-first-column", "no-grid", "overlapping-duplicate").

page_text_regions_detected.description: Non-table scan regions recovered with sparse-layout word OCR while rebuilding a detected table page.

page_text_words_resolved.description: Positioned sidecar words recovered from non-table scan regions.

input_bytes.description: Decoded input PDF size in bytes.

output_bytes.description: Returned sanitized visual PDF size in bytes. Zero for geometry-only jobs and jobs that fail before producing output.

decode_ms.description: Milliseconds spent base64-decoding the inbound PDF.

input_sanitize_ms.description: Milliseconds spent rewriting the input PDF into a passive document before any third-party PDF or OCR processing.

inspect_ms.description: Milliseconds spent opening the input PDF to determine its page count for diagnostics.

primary_ocr_ms.description: Milliseconds spent in direct page recognition, including selected retry passes.

adaptive_ocr_ms.description: Subset of primary_ocr_ms spent on direct Tesseract retry passes.

geometry_encode_ms.description: Milliseconds spent serializing, compressing, and base64-encoding text geometry.

pdf_encode_ms.description: Milliseconds spent base64-encoding the returned OCR PDF.

preflight_geometry_ms.description: Milliseconds spent extracting and validating source PDF text geometry before OCR.

native_pages_reused.description: Pages whose trustworthy source text geometry was reused without OCR.

direct_ocr_page_count.description: Pages rendered and recognized through direct Tesseract hOCR geometry.

direct_ocr_page_numbers.description: One-based pages sent through direct OCR.

direct_retry_page_count.description: Direct OCR pages retried at 400 DPI because 300-DPI confidence or coverage was weak.

direct_retry_page_numbers.description: One-based direct OCR pages retried at 400 DPI.

direct_400_selected_page_numbers.description: Retried pages where 400-DPI geometry materially beat the 300-DPI result and was selected.

direct_rotated_page_numbers.description: Direct-OCR pages whose validated orientation retry was selected. Their character boxes are inverse-mapped into the unchanged source-page coordinate space.

direct_mean_confidence.description: Mean Tesseract word confidence across the selected direct OCR page results.

pdf_sanitized.description: True when the returned PDF was rewritten as passive content before workbook storage.

removed_embedded_files.description: Embedded or attached files removed while normalizing the returned PDF.

removed_links.description: Interactive PDF links and actions removed while normalizing the returned PDF.

ocr_ms.description: Milliseconds spent in direct Tesseract recognition. Omitted when no OCR ran.

geometry_ms.description: Milliseconds spent extracting and recovering sidecar character geometry.

total_ms.description: Milliseconds from the start of inbound base64 decoding through response payload preparation, measured inside the worker. Excludes final JSON serialization, stdout transfer, and host-side workbook storage.

OcrSuccessMessage.description: Emitted by the worker to stdout when OCR completes successfully. Exactly one per job.

pdf_base64.description: Base-64 encoded sanitized visual PDF bytes. Omitted for geometry-only jobs. OCR text is never written into these bytes.

table_structure_base64.description: Gzip-compressed table-structure-v1 JSON, base64-encoded. Present for full OCR jobs when optional table detection succeeds.

OcrErrorMessage.description: Emitted by the worker to stdout when OCR fails. Exactly one per job.

diagnostics.description: Best-effort partial telemetry collected before the failure.
